finding.text: Toggling "show raw" (and setting a title on a not-yet-refined prompt) leaves the prompt's nest stale (requirement 2, "re-renders only that item's own element"; page 1) — `ChatV2.patch` re-renders only head and raw, but `prompt_nest` filters anchored replies by `raw_open`/`refined`, so after "show raw" an anchored reply shows both beside its sentence and in the nest (duplicate data-id); after a title lands the anchored replies of a sentence-view prompt vanish from view. Read from ChatV2.js:patch vs prompt_nest; no test covers it.

The shots show the wrong page (page 2) — shots/ holds only `.../chat-v2/renderer/` (a mostly empty task page, `empty 0.89–0.95`), not `/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`, the page this diff changes. Layout, sizing, wrapping, spacing and colour cannot be judged for the chat; re-shoot the Chat v2 page.

`ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` is stale: it says "38 checks" (Classes, ChatV2.test.mjs) but the last commit f19ff1be6 has 41; it also doesn't mention that a root Task/Question with `from` nests live, or that `reset()` drops the model (the commit's own additions).

The task folder can't be continued alone: session.jsonl ends at the shots line with no final commit hash (f19ff1be6 landed after the 2 logged), no pass count, no decisions line; `in-place/` has no page.jsonl or files index, and `review/` was indexed in `renderer/page.jsonl` instead (see the diff) — a different task's page.

The test checks `window.scrollY` after `scrollTo(0,400)` only, with no check that the page was actually scrollable/mid-page or of a chat scroller's `scrollTop` (requirement 3) — the fixture may not be tall enough for 400px to hold.
`ChatV2Model.answer_at` was added (requirement 5) but nothing in the view or test reads it.
Widths given: all four (400, 1200, 1920, 3440), but of the renderer page, not the chat.
